an5.17:1.4: They are personally accomplished in immersion, but they don’t encourage others in immersion;
an5.17:1.5: They are personally accomplished in wisdom, but they don’t encourage others in wisdom;
an5.17:1.6: They are personally accomplished in freedom, but they don’t encourage others in freedom;
an5.17:1.7: They are personally accomplished in the knowledge and vision of freedom, but they don’t encourage others in the knowledge and vision of freedom.
